Renting one at the garage: The RALLI-VUOKRAAMO garage, in Ässäkylä, left of the CARDINAL shop, displays rally cars. The rental agent is in the left-hand room, behind the desk: click on the agent, pick the car and the colour, then pay.
The price runs from 240 to 490 mk depending on the power-to-weight ratio. The car waits for you in front of the garage and replaces your current car. The F10 menu stays available.

The garage appears when the host has ticked \"CARDINAL parts shop\" and \"Players' Fiad 131 (F10)\" in Settings > Co-op > MWCoop additions: no separate setting. The menu offers the rally cars installed on your PC.
